tali.docs: Quick sync: devs keep hitting "fetch is not defined" from sample-apps on Node 16. We need a small, copy-paste friendly guidance block in quickstart.
kevin.sdk: Proposal: SDK should prefer globalThis.fetch when present, but export two helpers: `setFetchImplementation(fn)` and `hasGlobalFetch()`. This avoids global mutation for apps that dislike it.
anu.infra: Agreed. Also document recommended runtime matrix (Cloudflare/Vercel/Bun/Node 18+/Node <18) and one-line install/shim for legacy Node. Recommend undici@5 for Node <18.
maria.prod: From onboarding perspective we need clear examples for both ESM and CJS and a tiny troubleshooting table. People paste samples verbatim — keep it minimal.
kevin.sdk: Example snippets I plan to add: ```js
// ESM (Node <18)
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'
import { setFetchImplementation } from '@redwood/inference'
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
```js
// CJS (Node <18)
const { fetch: undiciFetch } = require('undici')
const { setFetchImplementation } = require('@redwood/inference')
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
tali.docs: Please also add a one-liner global shim for users who want the simplest fix: ```js
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'
if (!globalThis.fetch) globalThis.fetch = undiciFetch
```
anu.infra: Note: undici's stream/abort behavior can differ across versions. Call out caveats around streaming responses and retry semantics (auth token refresh + aborted streams).
kevin.sdk: We'll ship an internal tiny retry wrapper that only retries idempotent methods by default (GET/HEAD), uses AbortController, and exposes hooks for apps to override. Also export a `FetchLike` typedef: `(input: RequestInfo, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>` for TypeScript.
maria.prod: Add the runtime -> recommended setup table to console quickstart: Edge (no action), Node >=18 (no action), Node <18 (install shim), Bun (global with header quirks). That should reduce support tickets.
ci-bot: ci:tests triggered by @kevin.sdk — 2 failures (http-client-compat).
kevin.sdk: I'll investigate. Likely streaming tests failing with undici in CI image.
tali.docs: I'll draft the quickstart copy and include the troubleshooting table. If someone can attach example ESM/CJS files to sample-apps that'd be great.
anu.infra: I'll expand CI matrix to include Node 16/18/20 and run streaming integration.
kevin.sdk: Plan: implement setFetchImplementation + hasGlobalFetch + FetchLike typedef + opt-out retry wrapper + quickstart snippets. Opening PR shortly.
maria.prod: Thanks team. Keep docs minimal and let users opt into undici only when needed. :thumbsup:
